# Times Internet Languages Live

> Times Internet Languages Live is the vernacular-first events arm of Times Internet - a curated portfolio of region-first events across healthcare, education, entertainment & lifestyle, and MSMEs, built for the audiences, cities, and languages that move modern India.

- Audiences: brands and policymakers who sponsor or partner on regional event IPs; everyday Indians who attend, learn and register for summits.
- Cities: Delhi, Mumbai, Pune, Jaipur, Bhopal, Patna, Lucknow, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Surat.
- Languages: Hindi, English, Hinglish and regional languages.
- Partnerships: write to gaurav.vats@timesinternet.in or use https://timeslanguages.in/#partners

## Upcoming Events

- [Times Future of Maternity: South Edition 2026](https://timeslanguages.in/tfm-blr): Meet the doctors, hospitals, specialists, innovators, and trusted brands helping families across South India make informed choices. (October 2026, Bengaluru; language: en)
- [Nivesh Baithak: Surat Edition](https://timeslanguages.in/nivesh-baithak/surat): A Hindi-first investor education summit for everyday investors, learners, and wealth creators. (October 2026, Surat; language: hi)
- [India MSME Dialogue: Atmanirbhar Udyam | Atmanirbhar Bharat](https://timeslanguages.in/msme): A multi-state, multi-language platform uniting regional MSMEs. (September 2026, Uttar Pradesh; language: hi)
